raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-18 the payments source sends amount corrections in the daily delivery as a repeat of the txn_id with record_version incremented (26 rows have version 2). silver_transactions keeps both versions, so the txn_id is duplicated and the gold totals are double counted. The fix is to keep only the latest version per txn_id, then apply the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
